crossRefs.note: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked Yahweh to wrath.

people.name: Taberah
people.line: Israelite camp where God sent fire as judgment

translations.web: The name of that place was called Taberah, because Yahweh’s fire burned among them.
translations.bsb: So that place was called Taberah, because the fire of the LORD had burned among them.
translations.kjv: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt
translations.asv: And the name of that place was called Taberah, because the fire of Jehovah burnt among them.
